title: Split a god module into a package
prompt: inventory.py has grown into one big file. Turn it into a package inventory/ with models.py (Item), storage.py (Store), reports.py (format_report, restock_list) and cli.py (main). inventory/__init__.py must re-export Item, Store, format_report, restock_list and main so existing imports keep working, and `python -m inventory ...` must keep working (add inventory/__main__.py). Remove the old inventory.py. Run the tests afterwards.
